about: HB7a mapping: friction key -> trigger, scope, proposed home, source pointers. Written by Main (every key is `by main`, inferred); the owner corrects it by editing this file. Pointers only: label:<file>#<i> (the row's own i), record:<ws>/<id>, memory:<file>, doc:<repo path>#<heading>. No quoted text.

fix-brief-states-the-rule.trigger: a review finding names a family and the fix brief cites only the sample site
fix-brief-states-the-rule.correction: the fix brief states the rule that closes the family and asks for a test that proves the rule
fix-brief-states-the-rule.successful_action: one round closes the family: a parity table or a stub that proves the rule
fix-brief-states-the-rule.home_target: a brief-writing checklist doc that claude/main-prompt.md names for fix briefs
fix-brief-states-the-rule.why_home: it applies only when Main writes a fix brief for a finding family; a standing contract line would be paid on every turn
fix-brief-states-the-rule.worked_if: rounds-to-approve in one finding family drops on review-loop lanes after adoption (H12 eval)

parser-brief-grammar-first.trigger: a lane parses worker free text and the brief gives cases, not a grammar
parser-brief-grammar-first.correction: the first brief states the parser as a transition table and the test enumerates short combinations
parser-brief-grammar-first.successful_action: the parser lane approves without a new entry-validation round
parser-brief-grammar-first.home_target: the same brief-writing checklist doc (section: free-text parsers)
parser-brief-grammar-first.why_home: it applies only to parser briefs, a small class; Main retrieves it when the brief touches a parser
parser-brief-grammar-first.worked_if: review rounds per parser lane before and after (H22 check)

detector-fail-closed-first.trigger: a fix decides a security rule by parsing display or command text
detector-fail-closed-first.correction: the first brief states the fail-closed default (uncertain -> strictest) and the reviewer checks the default
detector-fail-closed-first.successful_action: the detector lane converges without a round per newly found text shape
detector-fail-closed-first.home_target: the same brief-writing checklist doc (section: text-based security detectors)
detector-fail-closed-first.why_home: it applies only to security detectors over text; retrieved with the security brief, not loaded on every turn
detector-fail-closed-first.worked_if: rounds in one source-path-redaction-like family on the next detector lane

model-choice.trigger: workers are dispatched on a model or effort the owner did not intend
model-choice.correction: dispatch uses the model family and effort the owner named for that work
model-choice.successful_action: the routed model matches the owner's stated choice without a reminder
model-choice.home_target: the per-model routing layer (model catalog and router profiles, H15 / HB7c)
model-choice.why_home: the choice is per model and provider; a prompt line cannot change what the router picks
model-choice.worked_if: no model-choice process label after the routing change lands

tools-serve-target-projects.trigger: Main evaluates a code-quality tool against tmux-pi itself
tools-serve-target-projects.correction: tmux-pi tools are evaluated on the target project tmux-pi works on (the battle-soccer clone), not on tmux-pi
tools-serve-target-projects.successful_action: tool evals name a target-project fixture from the first brief
tools-serve-target-projects.why_home: it is Main's standing purpose, needed whenever a tool lane is scoped; it is short and always applies
tools-serve-target-projects.worked_if: no purpose-or-scope-drift label of this point after the line lands

safe-search-from-start.trigger: workers search with shell grep and stop on sensitive-read prompts
safe-search-from-start.correction: workers use safe_grep and safe_read from the first call and Main's packet tells them to
safe-search-from-start.successful_action: no worker permission prompt from a recursive shell search
safe-search-from-start.why_home: it holds for every worker on every route, which is what the worker contract is for
safe-search-from-start.worked_if: worker permission prompts from recursive search per lane fall after the contract line (H27 count)

state-saved-for-restart.trigger: a compaction or session restart loses where work stood
state-saved-for-restart.correction: Main keeps task state in durable records and stops at a clean point before a restart
state-saved-for-restart.successful_action: after a restart Main resumes from records without the owner restating state
state-saved-for-restart.home_target: the work store checkpoint and session-start brief hooks (HB3 tp-agent brief)
state-saved-for-restart.why_home: a hook that always saves and re-reads state does not depend on Main remembering a rule at the moment it matters
state-saved-for-restart.worked_if: no recovery-after-compaction-or-restart label after the hooks are on by default

run-only-affected-tests.trigger: a coder runs the whole suite or unrelated tests while others wait
run-only-affected-tests.correction: a coder runs only the tests that check its change and stops other test runs
run-only-affected-tests.successful_action: lane workers run the affected set and name how they chose it
run-only-affected-tests.home_target: tp-agent dispatch --tests affected (the Test Scope packet section)
run-only-affected-tests.why_home: the dispatcher already computes the set; a default removes the choice instead of asking the worker to remember it
run-only-affected-tests.worked_if: no verification-or-evals label of this point after --tests affected became the lane default
